name: Niwairo
summary: Paint a Japanese landscape into being. In Niwairo you sweep a few watercolour brushes across an empty plot (hills, water, trees, paths, villages, ramparts) and the scenery builds itself under the paint: rivers fall down the hills in little waterfalls, blossoms fill the valleys, stone walls follow the ridges and villagers move in. No goals and no timer, just a calm place to shape at your own pace.
